summary:
All product category pages now share the clean, minimalist aesthetic established on the All Products page:
- Removed heavy Bento grids and explanatory overview lines.
- Each category features a clean celestial header with category title, sector eyebrow, and a curated poetic space quote with author credit.
- Minimalist SpaceLaserLine with sector coordinates and laser coordinate tick marks.
- Full-height moving celestial background with starfield particles and ambient planetary aura spanning to the bottom of the page.
- Direct dense 5-6 column visual product catalog with maximized imagery, compact typography, and quick preview slideshow popups on hover or tap.
